title: Join VENU’s Exclusive Live Investor Webinar and Q&A Session on July 22
summary: RedChip Companies will host an investor webinar on July 22, 2026, at 4:15 p.m. ET with Venu Holding Corporation (“VENU”) (NYSE American: VENU). The event will feature JW Roth, Founder, Chairman and CEO of VENU®, who will discuss how VENU’s differentiated live entertainment platform is redefining the traditional amphitheater model through a capital-efficient development strategy that combines public-private partnerships and proprietary Luxe FireSuite® ownership offerings. During the event, Roth will also discuss the Company's expanding portfolio of premium live entertainment venues - including multiple developments currently under construction - and growing pipeline of opportunities in underserved, high-growth markets, as well as VENU’s relationships with leading industry promoters, including AEG presents and Live Nation.
